document.about: A DOE task order modification (Section B update, 6 pages). Its Limitation of Funds tables group their CLINs under shaded period bands (`Base Period 1: …`, `Base Period 2: …`) whose labels are centred across the columns, under a shaded `CLIN | Funding Amount | Estimated Date` header. On page 5 the table starts at the page's foot with its header, the first band and two CLINs; page 6 goes on with the next band and no header.

notes: 2026-11-27: the first band was read as the header's second row, so every column was named `CLIN / Base Period 1: …`. On page 4 the bands further down the table did not show it a band: their labels, centred, ran over the columns' cuts and were dealt out among the cells. On page 5 the bands further down are on the next page.
2026-11-27: the part on page 6 opens on a shaded band, which ended the link to page 5's part as a new table's styled head would. Its rows had no column names.

checks.issue: Every column was named `… / Base Period 1: September 13, 2024 to September 30, 2025`.
The first band was header, not the section over CLINs 0001 and 0002.

cell.value: 0001 – Storage of Type 2 and Type 3 wastes in the Federal Waste Facility
